The grades screen lists the logbook, Form D, self evaluation, report and Career Fair components and the final percentage; the career fair score is recorded on the placement, then compute, moderate with a reason and publish, after which recomputation is refused. The academic mentor’s evaluation is shown for information and carries no marks.

Figure 4 shows the marking pipeline. The logbook component is the average of mentor-reviewed weekly scores as a percentage; supervisor and mentor components are their evaluation totals; the report component is the assessed report score. Weights come from the setting table, so a change applies to the next computation but never to a published mark. The total is rounded to two decimals, mapped to the grade scale and cached with component percentages. Moderation records a reason and moderator; publication sets status and timestamp and reveals the result.

Figure 4 shows the marking pipeline. The final mark is out of 200. Practical Internship carries 100 marks: the logbook is the share of placement weeks approved or mentor-reviewed out of 50, the Form D host supervisor evaluation contributes its stored total out of 40 and the student self evaluation its stored total out of 10. The Internship Report adds its assessed score out of 75 and the Career Fair adds a score out of 25; the weighted total is divided by 200 and reported as a percentage. The academic mentor’s evaluation is advisory and carries no marks. Weights come from the setting table, so a change applies to the next computation but never to a published mark, and the administrator’s form refuses practical weights that do not total 100. The total is rounded to two decimals, mapped to the grade scale and cached with the component percentages. Moderation records a reason and moderator; publication sets status and timestamp and reveals the result.

The seed demonstrates the arithmetic: logbook 75.00, supervisor 79.00, mentor 76.50 and report 76.00, weighted 20, 40, 20 and 20 per cent, gives 77.10, grade B+, “Very good”. The results page, grade sheet and management export read the same cached values.

The seed demonstrates the arithmetic on the published 2025/2026 placement: logbook 74.00, Form D 68.00 and self evaluation 80.00 give a practical mark of 72.20; the report contributes 54.00 of 75 and the career fair 21.25 of 25; 147.45 of 200 is 72.98 per cent, grade B. A current placement with a submitted Form D of 72.50, a self evaluation of 80.00, no approved weeks yet, a report of 78.00 and a career fair score of 76.00 computes to 37.00 practical and 57.25 per cent. The results page, grade sheet and management export read the same cached values.

A first-time student is offered a five-step tour that can be restarted from the layout at any time.

The guided tour is role-aware and page-aware: it opens with the signed-in role’s own workspace, adds the current page’s key control — the CV step and ranked list on Apply, the review queue for a supervisor, the grade sheet for the coordinator — and ends on the navigation, notification and profile controls, so it can be restarted from the layout or the demo strip at any time.
inserts: An application is one page: the student uploads or replaces a CV, sees a receipt with the file name and time, and ranks up to five hosts with a reason for each, while the coordinator records at allocation whether the placement is external or in-house. A separate self evaluation page lets the student score their own work against four criteria; once submitted it is read-only and it contributes 10 of the practical marks.
